opportunities.title: Authors' Contingency Fund

amount.raw: Grants range in value and are designed to meet immediate need

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Professional authors resident in the UK or British citizens (fiction writers, illustrators, literary translators, scriptwriters, poets, journalists and others) for whom author-related activities make up a substantial amount of their annual income. Not open to editors, copywriters or salaried journalists. Membership of the Society of Authors not required.
opportunities.summary: Small, short-term hardship grants for established authors in financial difficulty or moments of crisis, to help them return to their normal working practice (e.g. lost income, unexpected expenses, illness impact, one-off costs).

opportunities.title: Authors' Foundation
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Writers previously published or with a contract for their project with a commercial UK or Irish publisher (sole author/translator, non-contributory contract), or scriptwriters previously professionally performed/commissioned in the UK or Ireland. Hybrid/self-published works not eligible. Membership not required.
opportunities.summary: Grants to help develop a work-in-progress (fiction, non-fiction, poetry and script projects), funding research, travel or other expenditure. Applicants are automatically considered for associated named awards (Eric Ambler, Taner Baybars, John Brooks, Antonia Fraser, Arthur Welton, Great Britain Sasakawa Grant).

opportunities.title: K Blundell Trust
opportunities.eligibility_summary: British authors under the age of 40 (under 40 on Sunday 1 March 2026), British by birth and resident in the United Kingdom, with a previous sole-authored work published by a commercial UK publisher. Hybrid/self-published works not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Work-in-progress grants for British authors under 40 whose work aims to increase social awareness. Accepts fiction, non-fiction, poetry and script projects. Currently closed and will re-open for applications in 2027.

opportunities.title: Society of Authors' Access Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to all authors (anyone who creates work for publication, broadcast or performance, meeting SoA membership criteria). Open to UK and Irish residents and British and Irish citizens. Membership not required.
opportunities.summary: Small grants for travel, subsistence, childcare/carer support, accommodation, and other access needs for authors attending events, residencies and retreats. Currently closed and expected to re-open for applications in 2027.

opportunities.title: Strachey Trust Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to all authors (as defined by SoA Full Membership criteria, though membership not required) who are UK resident or British citizens, working on a specific full-length literary project with a strong likelihood of publication. Projects must be full-length books.
opportunities.summary: Grants to enable authors to travel to a UK or Republic of Ireland archive or collection to research manuscript material (letters, diaries or other unpublished matter) for a specific full-length literary project. Assessed on a rolling basis.
